The '''1977 [[Eliteserien|1. divisjon]]''' was the 33rd completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]].

==Overview==
There were 12 teams in the division. [[Lillestrøm SK]] emerged as the championship victors, their third league title. Lillestrøm's 36 points was at the time a record for most points in a season, two more than [[Viking FK|Viking]] and [[Fredrikstad FK|Fredrikstad]] achieved in the [[1972 1. divisjon|1972 season]].
